name: Quantum Workplace
summary: Quantum Workplace sells engagement, pulse and lifecycle surveys with team and individual reports for managers. Pricing is by quote and depends on employee count and the products bought. The pricing page states a minimum annual contract of $15,000, which rules out very small companies.

facts.text: Quantum Workplace says pulse surveys can collect attributed, confidential or anonymous feedback.

Its help library recommends the Confidential option, under which nobody at the organization gets raw results tied to individual respondents. Confidential and Mixed surveys withhold results until a minimum response count is met, and the article does not state the number.
The Mixed option lets admins export survey data that optionally contains participant information.
On the pricing page, there is no implementation fee, and three service tiers are described: Signature, Signature Plus and Premium.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: Base pricing depends on total employee count and products bought. Minimum annual contract is $15,000

hiddenCosts: Premium adds a dedicated Insights Analyst and live manager training, and Signature Plus adds annual engagement survey implementation and analysis, so service tier raises the quote.
